spotify.name: Spotify music
spotify.source: Spotify loudness normalization: plays at -14 LUFS, asks for true peak at or below -1 dBTP

integrated_lufs.why: anything louder is turned down to -14

apple-music.name: Apple Music
apple-music.source: Apple Sound Check: about -16 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

podcast.name: Podcast / spoken word
podcast.source: Apple Podcasts guidance: -16 LUFS +/-1, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

ebu-r128.name: EBU R128 broadcast
ebu-r128.source: EBU R128: -23 LUFS +/-0.5 (file delivery), true peak at or below -1 dBTP

atsc-a85.name: US TV (ATSC A/85)
atsc-a85.source: ATSC A/85: -24 LKFS +/-2, true peak at or below -2 dBTP

film-streaming.name: Film / series stream mix
film-streaming.source: Netflix-style spec: -27 LKFS +/-2 dialogue-gated, true peak at or below -2 dBTP
film-streaming.notes: the spec gates on dialogue; this tool measures the full mix, so treat loudness as approximate

game-console.name: Game mix, console / PC
game-console.source: Sony ASWG-R001 loudness: home console -24 LUFS +/-2, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

game-mobile.name: Game mix, mobile
game-mobile.source: Sony ASWG-R001 loudness: portable -18 LUFS +/-2, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

roblox-music.name: Roblox background music
roblox-music.source: house target (not an official Roblox spec): sits under SFX and voice, mixes for phones

integrated_lufs.why: leave room for SFX on top

band_sub_pct.why: phone speakers cannot play sub; it eats headroom

loop_seam_db.why: loops should not jump in level

roblox-ambience.name: Roblox horror ambience loop
roblox-ambience.source: house target for Last Train Out: dark, quiet, seamless beds under everything

centroid_hz.why: dark and low reads as dread

duration_s.why: short loops are easy to notice

roblox-ui.name: Roblox UI click / blip
roblox-ui.source: house target: short, instant, clear on phone speakers

centroid_hz.why: phone speakers live in the mids and highs

channels.why: UI sounds are centred; mono halves the size

roblox-impact.name: Roblox hit / impact
roblox-impact.source: house target: punchy transient, weight, short tail

roblox-footstep.name: Roblox footstep
roblox-footstep.source: house target: quick, soft, repeatable without fatigue

voice-dialogue.name: Voice line / dialogue
voice-dialogue.source: common dialogue practice: clean floor, intelligible presence, controlled peaks
